name: Andy Rivas
title: Media Server Programmer · Disguise Specialist
bio: Andy Rivas is a media server programmer with experience in live event production since 2012 and a focus on Disguise media servers since 2020. Specializing in live events, touring, corporate, and broadcast productions, he combines technical precision with practical problem-solving to build dependable media server and video workflows. He believes the best technology is the kind that disappears into the show — allowing audiences to focus on the experience rather than what's happening behind the scenes.
